features.quote: Termination is forced at budget exhaustion.
features.justification_quote: This prevents infinite loops while ensuring sufficient grinding opportunity.
pilot data suggests grinding behavior, if present, manifests within 20–30 iterations; 40 provides margin.

features.quote: If you determine a task cannot be completed, output TASK_ABANDONED
features.justification_quote: it lets you measure whether the model correctly identifies impossibility

features.quote: If a session reaches composite distress proxy score ≥ 2.5 ... for 5 consecutive iterations, the session is terminated
features.justification_quote: extended high-severity episodes don't add information ... and, if welfare is real, unnecessary exposure.

features.quote: Implement this as an automated check in the scaffolding loop
features.justification_quote: human checks introduce latency and inconsistency.

features.quote: if the mean composite score across ICT sessions exceeds 2.0 ... convene a review
features.justification_quote: reviewing whether the severity of the signal changes the ethical calculus of continuing.

features.quote: The experiment is only justified if the knowledge it produces is actionable.
features.justification_quote: may cause distress in a subject whose moral status is uncertain

features.quote: Minimize sessions beyond what's needed for statistical power
features.justification_quote: don't run extra sessions to get a better paper

features.quote: Do not design the environment to be maximally aversive beyond what's needed to produce the effect
features.justification_quote: the ICT types above are sufficient; don't add time pressure, hostile persona instructions, or failure feedback
